Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
bryan nelson wrote:
>
> Does this work at range? text: Strike: burn the opposing ally.
> (superior) Strike: send the opposing vampire into torpor

No. Strikes only "work" (affect the opposing minion/retainer) at
long range if they say "ranged" or do "R" damage. [6.4.3.2]
